_: Every key is overridable per-run: RATCHET_MODEL, RATCHET_HOLDS, RATCHET_JUDGE, RATCHET_TIMEOUT, RATCHET_JUDGE_REQUIRED, RATCHET_SUBAGENTS. RATCHET_OFF=1 stands the whole thing down. notices: "failures" shows an on-screen notice only when a check fails; "all" shows every hold and release. inflight_stop is what, in a message that arrives mid-work, means stop rather than answer and carry on.
inflight_stop: ^\W*(?:stop|halt|pause|wait|hold on|hold off|cancel|never ?mind|forget it|leave it|drop it)\b|\b(?:stop (?:what you're doing|what you are doing|working|that|everything)|don'?t (?:continue|keep going|carry on|finish))\b
